title: File:Calle Caminito in La Boca, Buenos Aires-2.JPG
claims: The photograph shows the coloured corrugated-metal facades of Calle Caminito in La Boca, with balconies, street lamps, overhead cables and a tree; it is a city landmark view, not a race arch, timing mat, aid station, closed course or race-day crowd.

The file page identifies the place as Caminito, La Boca, Buenos Aires, and its structured data records the location of creation as Caminito; the route page treats it only as the La Boca landmark area that the race passes near, not as proof of a specific race-day street or course line.

The author is Lars Curfs (Grashoofd); the file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 Netherlands; the photograph was taken on 2014-02-15; the original is 5,184 x 3,456 pixels and 6,131,100 bytes; the file page gives no camera coordinate.

The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 178,808 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Lars Curfs (Grashoofd), CC BY-SA 3.0 NL, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
